Codex review: needs changes before merge. _Reviewed August 12, 2026, 4:07 AM ET / 08:07 UTC._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes Adds selectable session-diff scopes plus a richer Control UI viewer with file actions, sync instructions, and persisted layout controls. ## Merge readiness ⚠️ **Ready for maintainer review - 2 items remain** Keep open: the prior commit-history boundary finding is fixed, but commit-scoped file actions still open the live working tree rather than the selected historical revision. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `7b2934bc8c836260f736b79a38ba2cbebbcde1cf` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Useful, well-evidenced feature work with one bounded correctness issue in historical file actions. | | **Proof confidence** | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Not applicable: This member-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate; its body nevertheless includes UI screenshots and mock-Gateway browser evidence. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Not applicable | Not applicable: This member-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate; its body nevertheless includes UI screenshots and mock-Gateway browser evidence. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 7 items | Current main behavior: Current main has a single no-argument diff loader, so it does not already provide the proposed commit and uncommitted scopes.
Historical diff fence: The PR resolves a commit and permits it only when it is reachable from HEAD but not from the resolved merge base, then diffs its parent-to-commit object range.
Prior finding regression coverage: Real temporary-git-repository coverage accepts a feature commit and rejects sibling, merge-base, and invalid commits with unknown_commit. | | **Findings** | 1 actionable finding | [P2] Disable working-tree actions in commit scope | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The Control UI requests a session checkout diff from the Gateway and renders its files in the chat sidebar. The Gateway selects either working-tree state or a fenced commit diff before returning the result. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Session checkout] --> B[Gateway diff service] B --> C[Scope and commit validation] C --> D[Git history or working tree] D --> E[Structured diff response] E --> F[Control UI diff viewer] F --> G[File action menu] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Disable working-tree actions in commit scope (P2)** - Commit diffs are read from the selected Git object, but these actions pass only a path to the live workspace reader/editor. A file deleted by that commit cannot open, and a file changed later opens HEAD rather than the revision being displayed. Hide those actions for commit scope, or add a revision-aware reader behind the same history fence. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - A narrow UI guard and browser regression test can repair the remaining mismatch without changing the Gateway protocol. ## Findings - [P2] Disable working-tree actions in commit scope — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/session-diff-panel.ts:230-237`
Agent review details ### Security None. ### PR surface Source +1286, Tests +222, Docs 0, Generated 0, Other +44. Total +1552 across 40 files.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 15 | 1444 | 158 | +1286 | | Tests | 4 | 263 | 41 | +222 | | Docs | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 19 | 19 | 19 | 0 | | Other | 1 | 45 | 1 | +44 | | **Total** | **40** | **1772** | **220** | **+1552** |
### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test LOC** | production +1,489/-159 (net +1,330); tests +263/-41 (net +222); generated/docs net 0 | The substantial feature growth is purposeful, but the historical-action boundary needs correction before merge. | | **Gateway protocol surface** | 1 optional scope parameter, 1 optional commit selector, 3 optional response metadata fields | The additive contract preserves existing callers while exposing scope and branch metadata to the Control UI. | ### Stored data model Persistent data-model change detected: `serialized state: packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/sessions.ts`, `serialized state: src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts`, `serialized state: src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.ts`, `serialized state: src/sessions/session-diff-revisions.ts`, `serialized state: src/sessions/session-diff.ts`, `serialized state: ui/src/lib/chat/session-diff-split.test.ts`, and 12 more. Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Technical review Best possible solution: In commit scope, hide working-tree-only actions while retaining Copy Path, and add a browser regression test; introduce a revision-aware file API only if historic file opening is explicitly required. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes, source-reproducible: select a commit that deletes a file or predates a later edit, then choose a file action; the action reads the live workspace path rather than the selected commit. Is this the best way to solve the issue? No. The object-database diff is correctly revision-scoped, but its working-tree file actions contradict that scope; hide them for commit views unless a fenced revision reader is deliberately added. Full review comments: - [P2] Disable working-tree actions in commit scope — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/session-diff-panel.ts:230-237` Commit diffs are read from the selected Git object, but these actions pass only a path to the live workspace reader/editor. A file deleted by that commit cannot open, and a file changed later opens HEAD rather than the revision being displayed. Hide those actions for commit scope, or add a revision-aware reader behind the same history fence. Confidence: 0.98 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.98 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Not applicable: This member-authored PR is exempt from the external-contributor proof gate; its body nevertheless includes UI screenshots and mock-Gateway browser evidence. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - [P1] node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/e2e/chat-session-diff.e2e.test.ts. - [P1] node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts. What I checked: - **Current main behavior:** Current main has a single no-argument diff loader, so it does not already provide the proposed commit and uncommitted scopes. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.ts:54`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5a643e354310/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.ts#L54), [5a643e354310](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a643e354310)) - **Historical diff fence:** The PR resolves a commit and permits it only when it is reachable from HEAD but not from the resolved merge base, then diffs its parent-to-commit object range. ([`src/sessions/session-diff.ts:424`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7b2934bc8c83/src/sessions/session-diff.ts#L424), [7b2934bc8c83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b2934bc8c83)) - **Prior finding regression coverage:** Real temporary-git-repository coverage accepts a feature commit and rejects sibling, merge-base, and invalid commits with unknown_commit. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts:219`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7b2934bc8c83/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts#L219), [7b2934bc8c83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b2934bc8c83)) - **File-action mismatch:** The panel dispatches Open File and Open in Editor with only a path, while its loader sends scope only to sessions.diff; no revision is carried to the file reader. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/session-diff-panel.ts:230`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7b2934bc8c83/ui/src/pages/chat/components/session-diff-panel.ts#L230), [7b2934bc8c83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b2934bc8c83)) - **Live-workspace file contract:** sessions.files.get accepts only sessionKey, path, and agentId, then resolves and reads the current session workspace, not a Git revision. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.ts:792`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7b2934bc8c83/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.ts#L792), [7b2934bc8c83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b2934bc8c83)) - **Git contract:** Installed Git 2.52 documents merge-base --is-ancestor and two-commit diff forms used by the fenced commit path. ([`src/sessions/session-diff.ts:427`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7b2934bc8c83/src/sessions/session-diff.ts#L427), [7b2934bc8c83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b2934bc8c83)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Current-main blame assigns the existing session-diff owner path to this contributor, who also authored the feature and its boundary repair.
